scope: Public source review only. No source was copied into the Mod payload; no game-file modification, injection or multiplayer claim.

repositories.name: SkyeShade/HD2Runtime
repositories.license: Not established in this checkout; source is referenced only, not copied.

current_build_evidence.source: domains/event_natives.lua source.gameDllSha256, source.imageSize and source.exeImageSize; this file does not carry an EXE SHA-256

findings.player_layout: domains/event_natives.lua sets players.global=0x3326340, count=0x84, peers=0x2C8, peerStride=0x38, maxPlayers=4; stats.maxPlayers=4.
findings.player_reader: runtime/event_world.lua players() rejects count > maxPlayers and reads peer ids, lifecycle, descriptors and avatar network ids read-only.
findings.writer_boundary: runtime/windows_write.lua provides guarded writes and reviewed heal/explosion/projectile/status calls only; no Session, Party, peer admission, confirmed-peer, player creation or cleanup bridge.
findings.spawn_boundary: api/hd2.lua reports generic spawn_entity as blocked because network replication is not proven.
findings.value_to_project: Reusable same-build read-only player/event observer and native call guard; not an 8-player bridge.

findings.session_layout: src/game.lua declares CONTEXT_PTR=0x347cef0, PEER_COUNT=0x16390, PEERS=0x16398, PEER_STRIDE=32, PEER_INDEX=20, MAX_PEERS=4.
findings.roster_layout: src/game.lua declares ROSTER_PTR=0x347ced8 with four 0xC0-byte persona records.
findings.call_boundary: src/windows_api.lua can cast known function addresses through api.native and write only existing private data after VirtualQuery; it has no confirmed-peer/player-creation ABI.
findings.value_to_project: Same-build offsets, byte gates, native-call type pattern, diagnostics and logs can inform a probe; four-slot constants cannot be expanded by this source alone.

findings.loader_boundary: API 1, addon discovery, logging and failure isolation; the loader itself performs no process-memory writes and exposes no peer/session API.
findings.value_to_project: Potential package/diagnostic envelope only; native payload needs a separate, versioned bridge and install path.

host_capacity_gate_0x108c18f.reason: No reviewed public source patches this mid-function or supplies continuation/unwind.

host_index_allocator_0x108c3d8.reason: Public loaders only read/write data and call already-known functions; no allocator contract.

confirmed_peer_sender_0x108c760.reason: No public source binds event hash 0x4804FCF4 to a production 8-slot sender.

client_confirmed_peer_insert_0xb90b20.reason: HD2Runtime and BetterLobby expose read-only player/session readers; client append remains four-record in-object storage.

player_creation_gate_0x1086460.reason: HD2Runtime explicitly blocks generic network spawn; no public ABI for the missing index 4..7 resource path.

departure_cleanup_host_migration.reason: BetterLobby uses the game's own kick/host migration; no 8-slot cleanup or resource-handle lifetime bridge.

decision.reusable_public_source: HD2Runtime read-only player/event observer, BetterLobby same-build fingerprints and native-call type pattern, Bingus loader packaging/logging
decision.next_strong_evidence: A fixed-build diagnostics run must observe a real fifth peer/index through host sender, client insert, player creation and cleanup; public source alone cannot close these contracts.
